reason: Almost $68 up front, or $50 plus $13 shipping, is way too much for a water bottle on my budget, and I'd be signing up to keep paying for filters. Nothing in the video tells me it looks any better than the $25 bottle I already carry to the gym.
objection: $40-50 is a lot for a water bottle, and then there's a filter subscription on top. My tap water is fine, so I'd mostly be paying for the look, and I haven't even seen that it looks great.
would_change_my_mind: If the bottle on its own came in under $30 with free shipping, no subscription, and a design that actually looks good on my desk
